title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: This week’s MLB Draft is LOADED with talent
@DetroitTigersPR don’t forget to have Ben Fiddleman tweet out the draft board with every player’s agent like last year. It was very helpful.
Putting some tweets in the hopper tonight, Greg
Getting those almost off furlough jitters
At least one reporter has learned who the Tigers will select with the No. 1 overall pick in the 2020 MLB Draft, but he is on furlough. Hate it when that happens.
I can tell you this: The Tigers are not trading down from No. 1, they are drafting whom they deem to be the “best player available,” and that player is not a tight end.
The last one has been used before in some variation.
The furlough one before it is v good
By me? Yeah, twice I think
The Lions tight end. I used that two drafts in a row. It always does really well, though
How many Africans do you think the Tigers have on their baseball operations staff
Africans like Trump says it
They have more Avila’s on their baseball operations staff than they do African americans
The Tigers staff is very very white
I think it’s non-existent actually
The number of african Americans in baseball ops. Unless you count Lloyd, Dave, Phil
Yeah, I’m not counting them
It’s Willie Horton
That’s it
The thing is, Al’s also the only minority GM or close
Do you think they’ll have him prepared for a diversity question? For a draft call
Most definitely
Wow
Feel like you’re giving them a little too much credit
